Vehicle quickhack · DV16 · Cooldown 20 Rounds · 2 slots

Every electrical upgrade dies (onboard weapons, Comms Center, Personal Link control) until a Manual System Reboot. AVs and hovers drop 10m a Round until restored; a crash is 6d6 and Whiplash for all aboard.

Interface + 1d10 vs DV16. 10,000eb (Super Luxury). Cyberpunk: The Unification Era, Core Rules Chapter 10.
